[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]1,000 (Sandbox) |defense = {{Defense}}25% |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (4) |cash = {{Money|1,312}} every 50% health |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Stun}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Industrial Military Terrorism}}''' - Shoots out three plasma projectiles from its plasma blaster at a tower or unit in its range of 20, creating an explosion with a 6 explosion radius that stuns towers for 3 seconds and deals 500 damage to units. |ability1_cooldown = 10 }} ==Description== The '''Super Soldier Ducky''' was an enemy that appears in [[Bathroom Approach]] Hard difficulty as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. It is a stronger version of the [[Missile Ducky]]. It has high health, a bit lower than the [[Ducky Unit (Ducky Revenge)|Ducky Unit]], 25% defense making most sources of damage deal 20% less damage to it and above average speed. It has one ability where it will fire three plasma projectiles from its plasma blaster at units and towers in its range of 20. These plasma blasters create explosions with a radius of 6 that stun towers for 3 seconds and deal 500 damage to units. ==Logbook Description== "''Super Soldier Duck is what "beak" performance looks like. He is the type to take himself too seriously and can be overdramatic when it comes to his dramatizations of past events, telling insane mission stories like flying a jet through a train tunnel and kidnapping someone named "Scout." Although, who knows what stories are true.''" ==Appearance== The '''Super Soldier Ducky''' is a small, armored yellow duck. It wears dark green chest armor, boots and gloves that it wears on its wings. It also has a gas mask with a green visor over its head. It wields a plasma blaster with its right wing, which it uses to attack towers and units. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]], [[Turret]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Golden Minigunner]] are recommended against this. **The [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] are especially useful as they are immune to its stuns. **The [[Commander]] and the [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost the DPS of these towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1SSDucky.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseSuperSoldierDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} DuckHunt2025PI2.png|'''Super Soldier Ducky''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} SuperSoldierDuckyIconIG.png|'''Super Soldier Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Super Soldier Ducky''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' -
